steps.description: Create project config files: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.mjs, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, and app/globals.css with proper Next.js 14 + Tailwind setup.
Run npm install to install all dependencies.
Create app/layout.tsx with the root layout, metadata, and Tailwind provider.
Create the ChatSidebar component with conversation history UI.
Create the EmptyState component for the initial welcome screen.
Create the MessageList component to render user and assistant messages with markdown support.
Create the PromptInput component with textarea and send button.
Create the ChatLayout component composing sidebar, message list, and input.
Create a streaming mock assistant reply utility that generates text character-by-character.
Create app/page.tsx with the full chat UI using useState for messages and simulated streaming responses.
Run typecheck_workspace and fix every reported type or syntax error.
Start the dev server and use browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, and browser_screenshot to verify: empty state renders, typed messages appear, and assistant reply streams correctly.
